mapper.sql: id, product_id, seckill_price, stock, start_time, end_time, status, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM seckill_product WHERE status = 1 AND stock > 0 AND NOW() BETWEEN start_time AND end_time ORDER BY start_time ASC
SELECT FROM seckill_product WHERE status = 1 AND start_time > NOW() ORDER BY start_time ASC
SELECT FROM seckill_product ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO seckill_product (product_id, seckill_price, stock, start_time, end_time, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{productId}, #{seckillPrice}, #{stock}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE seckill_product SET stock = stock - 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND stock > 0
UPDATE seckill_product SET stock = stock + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE seckill_product SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
